## 9-Book Roadmap Structure

| Volume | Title | Core Conflict & Campaign | Key Characters |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| **Book 1** | *The Incursion* | The initial breach at Neptune; fall of the Martian colonies. | Capt. Jaxen Vance, Adm. Christopher Zhao |
| **Book 2** | *Revenant* | Outnumbered and cut off, battlecruiser *Revenant* executes guerrilla strikes behind enemy battle lines. | Jaxen Vance, Chief Tarek Thorne |
| **Book 3** | *Renegades* | Vance consolidates rogue captains and civilian refitted haulers into the irregular "Renegade Fleet." | Jaxen Vance, Cmdr. Eric Stride |
| **Book 4** | *Extinction* | The direct planetary assault on Earth; desperate defense of the Luna defensive ring and orbital elevators. | Adm. Christopher Zhao, Sol Marines |
| **Book 5** | *Yorktown* | Dreadnought *Yorktown* leads a massive armored counter-thrust into the Jovian mining colonies. | Cmdr. Eric Stride, Chief Gunner Kelly |
| **Book 6** | *Jamestown* | Ground warfare and boarding actions to liberate the subterranean mining complexes on Mars. | Major Sarah Briggs, Orbital Drop Shock Teams |
| **Book 7** | *Overlord* | Deep-space recon into the Oort Cloud; deciphering the psionic hive structure of the Incursion. | Jaxen Vance, Science Officer Chen |
| **Book 8** | *The Underground* | Asymmetrical insurgencies across occupied outer-moon orbital habitats and asteroid redoubts. | Renegade strike teams, civilian partisans |
| **Book 9** | *Victory / Tortuga* | The climactic fleet clash at the Kuiper Rift Gate; collapsing the spatial breach to secure mankind's survival. | Full Sol Coalition Fleet, Overlord Xylar |

---
